changelog:
Initial release of the "变化点管理CPM (Change Point Management)" skill.

- Enables production supervisors and quality engineers to identify, categorize, verify, and trace 4M change points, preventing mass defects.
- Provides guided process and templates for change identification, risk grading, labeling, verification, and traceability.
- Generates change point tracking ledgers in text and Markdown formats.
- Enforces mandatory input fields and process steps to ensure control and accountability.
- Clearly defines boundaries: does not replace ECN processes or make verification decisions—serves as an on-site management tool only.
summary: 面向生产主管与质量工程师的变化点管理（CPM）技能，对 4M 变化点进行识别-标识-验证-追溯，防止批量不良。
